subject: 해커스 수능영어독해 미니모의고사
title: 11회 8번 · 주어진 문장의 위치 찾기
fullPassage: The formation of auroras —bands of colored light visible in high-latitude regions at night— is initiated by activity on the Sun. The Sun, composed of extremely hot gases containing electrically charged particles, continuously emits these particles from its surface, forming what is called the solar wind. When the wind reaches Earth’s magnetic field, which protects the planet and its atmosphere, most of it is blocked and forced to travel farther into the solar system. However, some particles in it become temporarily trapped in ring-shaped holding areas that mark the tilted north and south axes of Earth’s magnetic field, about 800 miles from the poles. In these areas, they collide with atoms from Earth’s atmosphere, mainly oxygen and nitrogen atoms, creating a lot of energy. This results in colorful, glowing, undulating light displays —auroras. The specific colors seen in auroras depend on the type of atoms involved in the collisions: for example, oxygen atoms typically produce green-yellow or red hues, while nitrogen atoms produce red or blue hues.
